notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Flicker of Fate from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Flicker of Fate without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Flicker of Fate, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
